pages.text: Create uses its own materials, made in steps. Early ones need little; later ones need heat and machines. Look up exact recipes in JEI with R.

pages.title: Andesite Alloy
pages.text: The first Create material. Andesite plus iron or zinc nuggets, crafted in a diagonal or mixed in a basin.

pages.title: Andesite Casing
pages.text: Right-click a stripped log with andesite alloy. Used to build early machines and to encase shafts.

pages.title: Zinc Ingot
pages.text: Smelted from zinc ore. Mixed with copper over heat to make brass. See $(l:materials/ore_guide)the Ore Guide$(/l) for where to find it.

pages.title: Brass Ingot
pages.text: Copper and zinc mixed in a heated basin. Brass opens the second tier of Create machines.

pages.title: Brass Casing
pages.text: Right-click a stripped log with brass. Needed for most advanced machines. See $(l:create_basics/brass_and_assembly)Brass and Assembly$(/l).

pages.title: Iron Sheet
pages.text: Made by pressing an iron ingot with a mechanical press. Brass and copper also press into sheets.

pages.title: Electron Tube
pages.text: Crafted from polished rose quartz over an iron sheet. Needed for circuits and many brass machines.

Copper is smelted from ore and pressed into sheets. Copper casing is for fluid pipes. Metals are shared across mods: see $(l:materials/ore_guide)the Ore Guide$(/l) and $(l:create_basics/processing)Processing$(/l).
